extracted.intended_audience: college-level English students and instructors analyzing short fiction
extracted.subtask_description: A college‑level framework for analyzing and evaluating short stories, listing core elements, language techniques, and guiding quality questions to structure close readings and essays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plot
rubrics_metrics.description: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, resolution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'Literary Elements (How a Story is Built)'. Consider structural progression and how events shape meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character
rubrics_metrics.description: protagonist, antagonist, foils, round vs. flat, dynamic vs. static
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess character roles, development, relationships, and how they drive plot and theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting
rubrics_metrics.description: location, time period, time of day, weather, social atmosphere, economic conditions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine physical and social context and how setting informs mood, character, and theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theme
rubrics_metrics.description: main idea, lesson, message about human condition / society / life
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify central ideas or messages and evaluate how other elements support or complicate them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of View
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analyze narrator perspective and its effects on what is revealed, withheld, or biased.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tone
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess language and stance that create the author's attitude and influence reader response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mood
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider how sensory detail, diction, and rhythm establish the reader's emotional experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style / Diction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate how language choices shape voice, clarity, and the story's aesthetic effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict
rubrics_metrics.description: person vs. person, self, society, nature, supernatural, technology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify central tensions and obstacles and how they generate plot movement and thematic meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metaphor / Simile
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under 'Literary Techniques (How Language Is Manipulated)'. Examine what is being compared and to what effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider how attributing human qualities shapes imagery or theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symbolism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify recurring symbols and interpret their relation to theme and meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imagery
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analyze sensory detail (visual, auditory, tactile, etc.) and its contribution to mood and meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreshadowing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note anticipatory details and their role in structure, suspense, or thematic resonance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flashback
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine how shifts in chronology reveal character motivation or alter understanding of the present narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allusion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider intertextual references and how they enrich or complicate meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irony
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify ironic contrasts between expectation and outcome, speaker intent and meaning, or audience knowledge and character knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyperbole
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how overstatement is used for emphasis, humor, or rhetorical effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understatement / Litotes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate restraint or ironic minimization and its tonal or thematic effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Onomatopoeia
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look at sound words for their contribution to imagery and sensory immersion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alliteration / Assonance / Consonance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analyze repetition of sounds and its effects on rhythm, emphasis, or mood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Motif
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track repeated elements and how they build thematic coherence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Juxtaposition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine placed contrasts and how they illuminate differences or tensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parallelism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider repeated structures and their rhetorical or thematic impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synecdoche / Metonymy
rubrics_metrics.description: part for whole / related thing for thing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret figurative substitutions and what they emphasize or conceal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anaphora / Epistrophe
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess deliberate repetition for emphasis, rhythm, or persuasive force.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chiasmus
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note mirrored structures and how inversion shapes meaning or emphasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pathos / Ethos / Logos
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider persuasive modes within narration or characterization and their effect on reader alignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defamiliarization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate techniques that renew perception by estrangement and their aesthetic or thematic purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verisimilitude
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how plausibility and detail create a believable fictional world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interaction of plot/character/setting to develop theme
rubrics_metrics.description: How do plot/character/setting interact to develop theme?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A quality check question: trace interrelations among structural elements to show how they cohere to produce thematic meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of View reveals more than it states
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the POV reveal more than it states?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether narrator perspective conveys implicit information, subtext, or unreliability beyond explicit assertions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration of literary devices with meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: Are literary devices integrated with meaning, or decorative?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether techniques serve the story's thematic and emotional goals or exist merely for surface effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title's comment on the story
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the title comment on the story?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the title as a lens or key that frames interpretation, irony, or thematic emphasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ending recontextualizes earlier text
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the ending recontextualize what came before?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether the conclusion changes the meaning of prior events, revealing new significance or irony.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gaps purposeful vs. sloppy (iceberg)
rubrics_metrics.description: Are gaps in the text purposeful (iceberg) or sloppy?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate omissions and ellipses to determine if they invite reader inference (purposeful) or reflect underdevelopment (sloppy).
